What is daily life really like in Comoros? Today we explore Moroni — its local markets, historic old town, Indian connections and volcanic coastline.
After finally getting some rest from our long journey, we start the day in Moroni and head towards Volo Volo Market, one of the busiest local markets on Grande Comore.
Along the way, we discover Comoros beyond the tourist side — traditional handmade caps, local businesses, everyday prices, Indian-origin families and the reality of doing business in this remote island nation.
